differences.what: massing: the draft's generic block is now the photograph's: a light ashlar house two storeys over a raised basement, 15.2 m of front, its wall head at about 10.75 m and the mansard's curb near 15.3 m; the house fills the print's x 130-820 px and the render's x 125-865 px

the porch on columns at the stoop's head, its entablature from about 5.1 m and its balustraded balcony before the window over the door, where the photograph puts it (x 230-400 px), about 1.5 m north of the 1911 sheet's box
the front's three window columns on both storeys (x 200-235, 320-355 and 455-500 px), each window under a moulded head with a cornice
the slated mansard with three pedimented-in-place dormers over the window columns and an iron cresting on its curb
the south flank's canted bay through both storeys under the cornice, its cheek and front lights
basement lights under the principal windows and an iron fence on a stone curb before the front

the front's south-west corner: the photograph cuts it on a canted face with its own window column and pedimented dormer (x 510-600 px); now K01's canted corner (cant_corner), cut 1.83 m each way as the south-west view's camera reads it, its window column, its dormer and the cornice and the mansard carried round it, where the photograph puts it (render x about 500-600 px)

the cornice: the photograph's is deep, a course of carved stone blocks (scrolled consoles with squared heads, single and evenly spaced about 0.8 m, dark panels between them) under its corona, standing on a plain frieze whose foot is a moulded band just over the chamber heads (x 145-510 px); now K10's moulded stone cornice over a stone frieze 0.42 m high with 57 scrolled stone blocks round the front, the canted corner and both flanks, 0.45 m high under the corona's soffit (render x 150-510 px). The band-to-corona depth builds 0.57 m where the print reads about 0.6-0.8 m, and the blocks' carving is the kit's generic scroll; under the 1 ft bar
differences.how: T-3186: wall_head.frieze {height_m 0.42, proud_m 0.025} and wall_head.blocks {spacing_m 0.8, height_m 0.45, projection_m 0.19, width_m 0.18} under the moulded stone cornice round the mansard (k10_frontage._stone_frieze_blocks)

differences.what: the dormers: the photograph's have low triangular pediments with carved cheeks, the middle one the largest, and a fourth over the canted corner; the render's three street dormers stand at K01's lowest pediment, 30 deg, the dormer over the flank's canted bay is built (the south-west view), and the canted corner's stands on its face at the middle one's size, its carved cheeks not built

the porch's capitals: Corinthian, a deep bell of leaves under the abacus; now K01's carved hood capital, two tiers of leaves under a 0.1 m abacus, about 0.45 m deep and 0.47 m across the leaves where the print reads about 0.45 m and 0.5 m (x 240-270, 330-365 px)
differences.how: T-3186: entrance_kit.hood.columns.carved {tiers 2, abacus_m 0.1}, the bay columns' carving (T-2887)

differences.what: the porch's paired shafts: about 0.5 m apart centre to centre in the print (about 18 px at 2.7 cm a pixel), 0.75 m in the render where K01 keeps their plinths 0.3 m clear; 0.25 m, under the 1 ft bar
the leafage's carving itself (its acanthus and volutes), finer than the print resolves

the stoop's cheeks: the photograph's sweep down and out in stone from the inner columns' feet to a roll at the walk; now K07's scrolled stone cheek either side, its head on the landing's edge beside the open terraces, its top running straight down the rake (bow 1) onto the rolled foot
differences.how: T-3186: entrance_kit cheek_form {kind scrolled, bow 1.0}, the scrolled cheek allowed beside open terraces at the landing's depth

differences.what: the cheeks' row of small openings under their tops (the north cheek's, x 330-380 px): now five openings through each cheek under its coping, along the upper part of the sweep; the pictures' are rounded, the build's squared, a difference under the 1 ft bar
differences.how: T-3186: entrance_kit cheek_form.pierced {count 5, hole_m [0.32, 0.2], under_m 0.12, span_m 2.5}, K07's pierced scrolled cheek (k07_entrances._scrolled_holes)

differences.what: the fence: scrolled iron panels between tall square stone posts at the gate and the corner; now K11's scroll-band fence on the kit's stone piers
the stacks over the south flank are stone in the exterior view; now laid in the walls' pale stone, at the places the south-west view's camera reads
the windows' heights: the photograph's north and south columns read about 0.6 m apart through the camera, and the build sits between them
the front's projecting middle block (x 265-400 px), a shallow break in the wall plane the sheet does not draw; under about 0.2 m
colour: the print is monochrome; the stone's buff and the slate's grey are the kit's
the north flank, the rear and the brick rear range
the walk and the entrance gate between the tall stone posts
differences.how: T-3206 adds the K14 walk from the stair to the public walk and stands the entrance gate open between the posts; the scroll fence is kept

differences.what: the stoop's height against its cheeks (the pedestals whole between the floor at y about 556 px and the shafts' feet at about 527, the cheeks' heads at about 534-537 px, the flight from about 556 to 605 px): now the porch's floor stands at the base course's top, about 1.5 m over grade (entrance_floor_m, nine risers of about 0.17 m), the columns on pedestals 0.8 m tall standing on it (hood columns plinth_m), and the cheeks' heads 0.6 m over the floor (cheek_form head_m), so the pedestals show whole above the cheeks as the pictures draw them; the cheeks' rolls stand on a 0.4 m foot block (cheek_form foot_block_m). T-3186 found the cause enlarging the 1898 print: the line read for the porch's floor at the stoop's head (y about 515 px) was the pedestals, and the floor lies at the stoop's top tread, level with the base course (y about 556 px); the door opens there on a vestibule whose inner flight, not built, climbs to the principal floor
the cheeks' heads: the print puts them about 0.15-0.25 m under the shafts' feet (y about 534-537 px against 527), the render about 0.2 m under; under the 1 ft bar
the cheeks' bulk: the print's are heavier, their coping about 0.4 m across and their rolls about 0.5 m, where K07's cheek is thinner and its roll 0.4 m; under the 1 ft bar
